entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: nil comparison on %s.%s is unsupported — the configured schema has no %s column
entries.rationale: the default OTel-CH traces schema configures attribute columns for every scope this branch checks; reachable only under a schema override that drops one

guard: past returning if op == traceql.OpNotExists && attr.Scope == traceql.AttributeScopeResource && attr.Name == "service.name"

entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: %s = nil is not valid because resource.service.name cannot be nil
entries.rationale: the parse-stage validator rejects `resource.service.name = nil` before lowering — validateNilComparison in internal/traceql/ast, which is the stage the reference applies this rule in (pkg/traceql/ast_validate.go) and the one whose errors the Tempo head answers 400 rather than 422 — so no wire query reaches this guard. It is retained rather than deleted because falling through it would emit a NOT mapContains(ResourceAttributes, 'service.name') predicate that is false on every conforming span; internal/traceql/nil_comparison_guard_test.go calls lowerNilComparison directly, past Parse, so unreachable does not decay into untested

guard: if op == traceql.OpNotExists && attr.Scope == traceql.AttributeScopeResource && attr.Name == "service.name"
